title: Building Vocabulary - Family and Friends
description: Learn words about family members and describing people.
competenceGoals: talk about family and people you know

content.content:
## Family and Friends

Let's learn how to talk about the people in your life! Family words and describing words are very useful.

content.title: Family Words
content.content:
**Close family:**
- mother/mom (mor/mamma)
- father/dad (far/pappa)
- sister (søster)
- brother (bror)
- parents (foreldre)

**Extended family:**
- grandmother/grandma (bestemor)
- grandfather/grandpa (bestefar)
- aunt (tante)
- uncle (onkel)
- cousin (søskenbarn)

content.title: Describing People
content.content:
**How people look:**
- tall (høy)
- short (kort/lav)
- young (ung)
- old (gammel)

**Hair:**
- long hair (langt hår)
- short hair (kort hår)
- brown hair (brunt hår)
- blonde hair (blondt hår)

**Personality:**
- kind (snill)
- funny (morsom)
- smart (smart/flink)
- friendly (vennlig)

content.title: Example: Describing Your Family
content.problem: How do you describe your family?
content.solution:
**Example sentences:**
- "I have one sister and one brother."
- "My mom has brown hair."
- "My grandpa is tall and kind."
- "My friend is funny."

**Template:**
"I have _____ (number) _____ (family member).
My _____ (family member) is _____ (describing word)."

exercise.task: What do we call these family members in English?
Write three sentences about your family or a friend. Use describing words!
exercise.solution: Example: "My brother is tall. He has brown hair. He is funny."
hints: Use words like tall, short, kind, funny, young, old

content.content:
## Oppsummering

I dette kapittelet har du lært:

- **Family words**: Words for family: mother, father, sister, brother, grandmother, aunt, uncle, cousin.
- **Describing looks**: Words like tall, short, young, old and types of hair.
- **Personality**: Words to describe people: kind, funny, smart, friendly.

### Hugs!
- 'cousin' means søskenbarn (both boys and girls).
- Describing words help you tell others about your family and friends.

exercise.task: Which word describes how someone looks?
What is the English word for 'tante'?
'My grandmother is very ___.' Which word fits to describe her personality?
Describe one person in your family in English. Use one looks-word and one personality-word.
exercise.solution: Example: 'My brother is tall and funny.' Any sentence with one appearance word and one personality word is correct.
hints: Use words like tall, short, young or old for looks.
Use words like kind, funny or friendly for personality.
